title: fix(client): publishItem JSDoc names NO_DRAFT, not the retired [no_draft] opener
body:
Fixes #19704

Clause-②: no

`publishItem`'s JSDoc in `packages/client/src/index.ts` (ships into `dist/index.d.ts`) documented the publish-refusal spelling as `404 [no_draft]` — the bracketed lowercase message opener the 2026-08-29 maintainer ruling retired from every `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` producer via #16245 / PR #19683 (`7a25a3ee9c`). The runtime has answered `status: 404, code: 'NO_DRAFT'` with no bracketed opener since that PR landed. This corrects the docstring to name `NO_DRAFT` on the `code` axis, following the same 404 `NO_DRAFT` convention already used in `packages/spec/src/api/plugin-rest-api.zod.ts`. No behaviour change.

The card's own `Blocked-by: #16245` is satisfied — that PR merged on 2026-09-22 (`7a25a3ee9c`). Triage originally planned to fold this card into #19705's round; per the claim's serial-constraints note, that round closed via a PR touching only QA files and never picked this line up, so this card proceeded on its own.

## Measured

- **Site confirmed**: `packages/client/src/index.ts:2152` read `404 [no_draft] when there is nothing to publish.` on `origin/main` `455dcc06`.
- **Tree-wide sweep**: `git grep -n --fixed-strings "[no_draft]"` over the tracked tree (excluding `content/docs/releases/` and `CHANGELOG.md`s) found no other present-tense claim of this spelling inside `packages/client/src/`. Control words in the same file — `NO_DRAFT` and `[item_locked]` are zero there while `publish` hits 55 times — show the grep discriminates rather than being silently broken.
- **Published-surface question (triage's UNMEASURED item)**: built `@objectstack/client` and grepped the emitted `dist/index.d.ts` — the docstring **does ship** (with positive controls, two neighbouring JSDoc lines, confirmed present too). This is a published-surface correction, so it carries `.changeset/19704-client-no-draft-jsdoc.md` (`patch`), not the `skip-changeset` route.
- **Runtime producer**: `SysMetadataRepository.promoteDraft` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts:946`) throws `status: 404`, `code: 'NO_DRAFT'`, message `"No pending draft exists for {type}/{name} — nothing to publish."` — no bracketed opener. The new docstring names exactly that.
- No test pins the old `[no_draft]` text (zero `git grep` hits across `packages/client/`'s test files).

## Acceptance notes

Two more present-tense claims of the same *retired bracketed-opener* shape turned up while measuring the above, both outside this card's file surface (packages/client/src/ + the [no_draft] spelling specifically) — reported rather than fixed here:

- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:8427` — a source comment (`404 [no_draft] when nothing to publish.`) on the same `POST /meta/:type/:name/publish` route this card's producer serves. Same defect family as #19704 and #16245, different file.
- `packages/client/src/index.ts:6297` — a sibling docstring (`Get a sharing rule by id or name. 404 [RULE_NOT_FOUND] when absent.`) for a *different* code. Its producer (`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-rule-service.ts:818`, bare `throw new Error('RULE_NOT_FOUND')`) and REST mapping (`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:12807-12808`, `:12920`) never emit a bracketed message either — the #16245 shape recurring on a code that ruling never touched.

Neither is the `[no_draft]` spelling this card claims, and the second isn't in scope by spelling; both are named in the round report for the dispatching seat to route.
